name: Snipcart API
tagline: Headless ecommerce cart and checkout API for custom storefronts
description: Snipcart provides a REST API for managing carts, products, orders, customers, discounts, and inventory on its hosted ecommerce platform. Developers embed Snipcart on any site and use the Dashboard API with secret keys for server-side operations such as listing orders, updating products, and managing inventory. Public and private API keys support client-side cart flows and authenticated backend access.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: Secret API key as username, empty password (Authorization: Basic base64(SECRET_KEY:)). Keys from Snipcart dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available for testing/development; transaction fees apply on paid plans (verify current tiers on snipcart.com/pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction-fee and subscription plans; see snipcart.com/pricing for current rates

use_cases: list and filter store orders for fulfillment
create or update products and inventory via API
apply discounts and promotional codes programmatically
fetch order details for custom admin dashboards
